HotelIntro.quote: In waters where time stands still, find a sanctuary that belongs only to you
HotelIntro.body1: Meili Resort is nestled in Semporna, Sabah, Malaysia, adjacent to the world-famous Sipadan Island. Home to one of the richest marine ecosystems on Earth, it is known as a diver's paradise.
HotelIntro.body2: Our resort blends modern comfort with natural beauty. Every room faces the ocean, letting you wake to gentle waves and fall asleep under a canopy of stars. Whether snorkeling, diving, or enjoying leisurely beach time, we fulfill every vision of a perfect holiday.

Story.title: BEAUTY PRESENTED BY MEILI
Story.subtitle: Real Stories, Timeless Moments
Story.headline: Our Beautiful Story
Story.desc1: In the unparalleled ecology of Semporna, we weave culture, architecture, and service into a poem written for the ocean.
Story.desc2: Join a dusk reef dive led by our lead marine biologist or sip grand cru champagne on your private beach.

posts.title: A Poem for the Ocean: Our Pledge from the Depths
posts.desc: Built upon century-old ironwood, our zero-emission living-water filtration system flows in endless cycles. Here, we never conquer nature — we bow before it in the most devoted reverence.

posts.title: Sea Gypsies: A Thousand-Year Ballad of the Bajau
posts.desc: Board a wooden boat into a hidden shallow-water village. In the pure, boundless smiles and bonfire songs of the indigenous people, slow the clock and engage in a dialogue that transcends language across time.

posts.title: Deep-Sea Freshness: A Symphony of Flavour at the Cliff's Edge
posts.desc: The freshest deep-sea catch delivered directly from morning fishing boats, paired with the chef's signature Nanyang treasures. In a clifftop restaurant suspended above the sea, let the ocean breeze and fine wine grace every private moment.

intro.title1: At the Heart of the Coral Triangle
intro.desc1: Meili Resort sits above the glass-calm waters of Semporna, Malaysia — at 4–5°N, 118–119°E, near the equator. Year-round temperatures of 26–32°C make it an ideal tropical escape.
intro.desc2: Semporna is naturally shielded by the Philippines' Mindanao island and Borneo, placing it in the permanent blind spot of typhoon tracks. In over 100 years, no typhoon has ever struck here — earning it the name "Land Below the Wind."
intro.desc3: The resort sits adjacent to Sipadan Island, the world's top-rated dive site, where sheer underwater cliffs and spectacular marine life draw divers from across the globe.

bajau.title: Guardians of the Sea for Centuries
bajau.desc1: The Bajau, known as the "Sea Nomads," have lived on these waters for generations. Born and raised on the ocean, they free-dive as naturally as they breathe, living in harmony with the coral reef for over a thousand years.
bajau.desc2: They are the most devoted guardians of this sea — and its most unforgettable story. At Meili Resort, you will have the chance to hear this ancient tale of humanity and the ocean.

arrival.subtitle: From your departure city to Meili Resort — seamless, exclusive transfers await
arrival.stage1Body: Board a domestic flight from Kuala Lumpur, Kota Kinabalu, or other cities. Tawau International Airport is just 1.5 hours away.
arrival.stage2Body: Your private hotel vehicle awaits at arrivals. Glide through Semporna's waterfront town as the sea air begins to slow time.
arrival.stage3Body: A private speedboat departs from the jetty. Thirty minutes of open ocean, and your island paradise comes into view.
arrival.footer: Your arrival is handled from the moment you land. Share your flight details after booking, and your personal butler will take care of the rest.

items.heading: Passports and Visas
items.content: All international travelers arriving in Sabah, Malaysia, must hold a passport valid for at least six months, along with a valid Malaysian visa or visa-free/visa-on-arrival entry permit. Entry policies may change over time, so please consult the relevant authorities regarding the latest requirements before your departure.

items.heading: Flights and Transfers
items.content: Guests are required to book their own flights to Tawau Airport (TWU). Upon arrival in Tawau, a 70-minute drive will take you to Semporna Pier. From there, we will arrange a private speedboat to carry you across the crystal-blue waters for about 45 minutes to our overwater resort. For safety reasons, speedboat transfers may be restricted at night; late arrivals may require an overnight stay in Semporna town before transferring to the island the following morning.

items.heading: Climate and Attire
items.content: Located near the equator, Semporna enjoys a warm, sun-drenched climate year-round. We recommend packing light and comfortable summer clothing, non-slip shoes for the speedboat deck, and ample sun protection. To preserve our fragile coral reef ecosystem and protect turtles and marine life, we kindly request that you bring and use only reef-safe sunscreen.

questions.q: How do I make a reservation?
questions.a: You can book through our official website, Trip.com, Booking.com, or contact us via WhatsApp (+6011 2780 3997) or Email (amy@meilihotel.com). Direct booking offers the best rates. We look forward to welcoming you to this private glass sea.

questions.q: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.a: We accept bank transfers and major credit/debit cards. Payment details will be provided in your booking confirmation.
Yes, a deposit is required to secure your booking. The deposit amount and payment instructions will be detailed in your confirmation. Some packages (e.g. all-inclusive) require full prepayment.

questions.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
questions.a: Check-in is from 14:00 (2:00 PM). Check-out is by 12:00 (Noon). Early check-in or late check-out is subject to availability and may incur additional charges.

questions.q: How do I get to the resort?
questions.a: Your journey is part of the experience. All-inclusive packages include round-trip transfers: Tawau Airport to Semporna Jetty by land (approx. 1 hr), then a private speedboat to Meili Resort (approx. 30 mins). Please provide full arrival details at least 3 days in advance.
Yes, round-trip airport transfers are included in all-inclusive packages. Please provide your complete arrival details so our team can be there to welcome you.

questions.q: What should I bring for my stay?
questions.a: We recommend: passport or valid ID, booking confirmation, personal medication, swimwear (multiple sets), reef-safe sunscreen, and non-slip shoes for the speedboat deck.

Free cancellation is available within the stipulated timeframe (see your booking terms). Late cancellations or no-shows will incur charges. Some promotional packages are non-refundable and require full prepayment.
Our all-inclusive packages include daily breakfast, lunch, dinner, and afternoon tea for two. Please refer to your specific package terms.
Yes, complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the resort — in villas and all public areas — so you can share your journey whenever you wish.
To protect our pristine natural environment and ensure comfort for all guests, smoking is permitted only in designated outdoor areas.

questions.q: What facilities does the resort offer?
questions.a: Infinity pool, overwater restaurants and bar, five-star dive club, sea golf practice range, full fitness centre, spa & wellness centre, six-star theatre, overwater event pavilion, children's water park, rooftop ocean terrace, stargazing, and 24-hour personal butler service.

questions.q: Can you arrange honeymoon or special celebrations?
questions.a: Absolutely! We would be delighted to make your special moment unforgettable. Please let us know your requirements in advance and our team will create a bespoke arrangement. (Additional charges may apply for special setups.)
Most welcome! Children aged 5 and under sharing an existing bed with parents stay complimentary. The spirit of exploration here is for all ages.
Yes, extra beds can be arranged upon request, subject to room conditions. Additional charges will apply.
As the resort is reached by private speedboat, parking is not available at the departure jetty. We recommend using public parking in Semporna town.
We regret that to protect the island's delicate ecosystem and ensure comfort for all guests, pets are not permitted on the island.
